compose_two_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs and verify the resulting graph is isomorphic
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a graph transducer to get the log-sum-exp of all path weights
find_viterbi_path: find the highest-scoring path through a graph transducer using the Viterbi algorithm
concatenate_graphs: concatenate multiple graph transducers in sequence to chain their input-output mappings
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a graph transducer and relink arcs to preserve language
